facts.fact: Mwango Brain, S.A. took on technical implementation, as executing partner, of the ADEA Education and Skills Data Challenge in Angola with the Education Ministry's planning and statistics office, to modernise the education management information system, including a national policy for it and training of national technicians.

AGO.note: The work is done by a private company, not government staff.
